scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,desktop "cross-env WELLLOG_DEV_CORS=1 python -m welllog_engine.api" "pnpm --filter @welllog/desktop dev"
scripts.lint: eslint . && python -m ruff check python tools
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && python -m mypy python/src tools
